name: Black Arrow (Lathspell Archetype)
body:
Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A black arrow is proficient in all simple weapons and martial weapons and light armor. Black arrows are not proficient with shields.

This alters the lathspell’s normal proficiencies.

Hunter’s Devotion (Ex)

A black arrow never gives up on a quarry. At 2nd level, the black arrow gains Point-Blank Shot as a bonus feat and also gain a bonus equal to 1/2 your level on Perception checks and Survival checks to follow tracks.

This ability replaces stubborn soul.

Menacing Sniper (Su)

The black arrow’s presence on the battlefield rattles enemies and leaves them open to magical assault. At 3rd level, whenever they deal damage to an enemy within 60 feet with a ranged attack who was denied their Dexterity bonus to AC or unaware of their presence at the beginning of the round, that creature takes a -2 penalty to saving throws until the beginning of the black arrow’s next turn. At 15th level this ability can affect enemies up to 120 feet away.

This ability replaces cloak of menace and greater cloak of menace.

Tracker Magic (Su)

The black arrow’s study of magic broadens to help hunt hunt rather than into other disciplines. At 5th level and every four levels thereafter, the black arrow may add two spells from the hunter spell list to their spell list and spells known. These spells must be of a level the black arrow can cast.

This ability replaces each instance of expanded knowledge.

Promised End (Ex)

The black arrow brings death to their targets, always. At 6th level, the black arrow increases the critical threat range of ranged weapons with which they are proficient by 1 and gain Clustered Shots as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites. At 11th level the black arrow increases the threat range of these weapons again by 1. These increases stack with other effects which increase critical threat ranges, but apply after all other modifiers.

This ability replaces armored casting at 6th and 11th level.
